name: Zigakibart
summary: Zigakibart (FUB523, formerly BION-1301) is a humanised IgG4 anti-APRIL antibody given by subcutaneous injection. Novartis got it with Chinook Therapeutics, which it bought outright in August 2023. The pivotal trial is BEYOND (NCT05852938): a Phase 3, placebo-controlled study of 600 mg every two weeks for 104 weeks, with proteinuria at week 40 as the primary endpoint. Novartis expects the readout in H1 2027 and a submission in 2027 (6-K 0001114448-26-000012). The price anchor is Voyxact (sibeprenlimab), the approved anti-APRIL antibody, at $399,499 a year with 25% off list. That is the same figure the book's povetacicept and sefaxersen seeds carry. Uptake is anchored on Filspari's measured capture, halved as a judgement for a third-to-market anti-APRIL. The curve is Tarpeyo's fitted launch.

therapy_mode.source: NCT05852938 (BEYOND): 600 mg zigakibart subcutaneously every 2 weeks for 104 weeks, followed by the open-label extension NCT06858319; Novartis 20-F 0001114448-26-000004 pipeline table: 'Anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody, IgA nephropathy, Subcutaneous injection'
therapy_mode.note: A maintenance antibody in a chronic disease, like the other B-cell agents the book models in IgAN.

list_price_per_patient.source: lookup.py seed Povetacicept: Voyxact (sibeprenlimab, Otsuka, FDA-approved in IgAN 25 November 2025). CMS Medicare Quarterly Part D Spending by Drug, Q1 2026: $4,640,341 over 151 claims is $30,730.73 a claim, and 13 four-weekly doses a year is $399,499. The sefaxersen seed carries the same figure.
list_price_per_patient.note: Voyxact is the closest marketed comparator: the same target (APRIL), the same disease and the same route. The price is per patient-year, not per dose, so zigakibart's every-two-weeks schedule does not double it. That assumes Novartis prices to the class, which is a judgement. The lookup.py demand table has no Voyxact row, because it holds annual CMS data only, so the figure rests on the povetacicept seed's quarterly read. Case against: Novartis could price below Voyxact to win share as a later entrant, or near Fabhalta's IgAN price. Fabhalta's CMS Part D 2024 figure is $252,095 per beneficiary (lookup.py demand Fabhalta), but that is mostly PNH use and a part year.

gross_to_net_pct.source: ICER, B-Cell Directed Therapies for IgA Nephropathy, Evidence Report, 9 February 2026, Table E2.3: IPD Analytics forecasts a 25% discount from WAC for sibeprenlimab (as carried on the povetacicept and sefaxersen seeds)
gross_to_net_pct.note: Net is 75% of list. Direction checked: this is the share OFF list. The house 0.5 is not used because the anchor is a list-type annual price for a new specialty launch, not a CMS per-beneficiary figure diluted by part years. Keeping the value keeps the three IgAN B-cell assets consistent.

discontinuation_pct.unit: share of the treated stock stopping per year
discontinuation_pct.source: lookup.py seed Povetacicept (carried on the sefaxersen seed too): Dulai PS et al., Crohn's & Colitis 360, 2026 (IQVIA PharMetrics Plus, 6,726 US adults with ulcerative colitis starting an advanced therapy): 38.1% still on their first advanced therapy at 36 months, which is 27.5% of the stock stopping a year
discontinuation_pct.note: Reused from the closest modelled competitors, because no US persistence series exists for an IgAN B-cell therapy yet. Case against: the source is persistence on a biologic in ulcerative colitis, not IgAN, and an every-two-weeks injection may persist worse than every four weeks.

forecast_start_year.source: Novartis Q2 2026 6-K exhibit (0001114448-26-000012, filed 2026-07-21): 'Zigakibart is currently being evaluated in the Phase III BEYOND study in adults with IgAN, with readout anticipated in H1 2027'. The pipeline table gives FUB523 IgAN a first planned submission of 2027 in Phase 3.
forecast_start_year.note: JUDGEMENT on timing. The sefaxersen seed measured Fabhalta going from its positive IgAN interim to accelerated approval in 10.2 months. On that pace, a mid-2027 readout gives approval around Q2 2028, so 2029 is the first full year. Case for 2028: a readout early in H1 2027 plus a priority review would put most of 2028 on the market. The extension NCT06858319 has a primary completion of 2031-06-25, but it is not the registration trial.

exus_multiple.source: Novartis FY2025 annual report product table (0001114448-26-000004), held in the book's asset_revenue_regions: Fabhalta US $317mm, rest of world $188mm, total $505mm; 188/317 = 0.593
exus_multiple.note: JUDGEMENT on the comparator. Fabhalta is Novartis's own renal-franchise product that carries IgAN, and its split is filed. Case against: Fabhalta's ex-US sales are mostly PNH. Ex-US IgAN reimbursement for a B-cell agent is untested, and China, a large IgAN market, prices low. The ratio may therefore overstate ex-US IgAN revenue.

economics_share.source: Novartis FY2025 20-F (0001114448-26-000004), Note 2: Novartis acquired all outstanding shares of Chinook Therapeutics, closing 11 August 2023, for $3.2bn cash plus up to $0.3bn of milestone payments to Chinook shareholders. The subsidiary list shows Chinook Therapeutics, Inc. held at 100%.
economics_share.note: Wholly owned, and no partner revenue share is disclosed. The contingent consideration is a milestone payment, not a revenue share. No third-party royalty on zigakibart was found in the filings the book holds, which is an absence of evidence, not a confirmed nil.

prevalence.note: lookup.py pool IgA: 198,887 from DeCongelio M et al., Clin Nephrol 2025, on the povetacicept seed and in epidemiology.csv. It is left null so two assets never carry two figures for one disease.

incidence.note: lookup.py pool IgA: 6,973 a year (DeCongelio 2025), carried in epidemiology.csv.

eligible_pct.source: lookup.py pool IgA (povetacicept and sefaxersen seeds): Caster DJ et al., Kidney Int Rep 2023;8:1792-1800, doi:10.1016/j.ekir.2023.06.016. 80.6% of 4,375 US adults with biopsy-proven IgAN are in CKD stages 1 to 4, and 85.0% have proteinuria of 1 g a day or more; 0.806 x 0.850 = 0.685
eligible_pct.note: Carried so the three IgAN B-cell assets share one label pool. BEYOND enrols adults with primary IgAN at risk of progression. Its exact proteinuria and eGFR entry thresholds were not re-read against NCT05852938 here, so the second reader should confirm that they match the 1 g a day filter.

penetration_peak_pct.unit: share of the eligible untreated pool captured per year
penetration_peak_pct.source: lookup.py seed Sefaxersen / Povetacicept: Filspari's $322.0mm of FY2025 US net sales (Travere 8-K exhibit 99.1, 0001438533-26-000013), at its CMS Part D 2025 price of $157,276 a year, is at least 2,047 patients, 1.50% of the 136,257 eligible. The povetacicept seed solved that to a peak of 0.0162 on this pool, curve and discontinuation.
penetration_peak_pct.note: JUDGEMENT: half of Filspari's solved capture, the same multiple the sefaxersen seed applies. Filspari is the incumbent actually measured. Zigakibart would be at least the third anti-APRIL to market, after Voyxact (approved November 2025) and povetacicept (PDUFA 30 November 2026), and it doses every two weeks against their every four weeks. Case against: Novartis sells Fabhalta and Vanrafia into the same nephrologists, which argues for more than half. A crowded B-cell class with atacicept also coming argues for less.

ramp_steepness.source: lookup.py seed Povetacicept: Tarpeyo's CMS Part D beneficiaries of 52, 247, 468 and 680 over 2022 to 2025, fitted by least squares to k = 1.32 with a midpoint at 1.70 years (rmse 17)
ramp_steepness.note: Reused from the closest modelled competitors, povetacicept and sefaxersen. Tarpeyo is the only IgAN-specific launch with a measured Part D series. Case against: Tarpeyo was a first-in-disease oral course, while a later-entrant injectable with an established class may ramp faster, since prescribers are already familiar, or slower, since it has to win share.

ramp_midpoint_year.source: Same Tarpeyo fit as ramp_steepness (lookup.py seed Povetacicept)
